platform: CJSW 90.9 FM Official Jotform EP and Album Upload Route
manual_review_reason: CJSW uses an official external Jotform and accepts only digital EPs or albums released within the last three months, with at least three unique tracks; singles are rejected. The full release must be uploaded as MP3 files in a .zip, and the form also requests release metadata, genre, location, bio, RIYL information, artwork, optional one-sheet and explicit permission to share the release with programmers and retain it in the digital library. The form contains an anti-spam field that must remain empty. A human must review the permission, asset rights, release date and all live form controls before upload.

platform: CKUT 90.3 FM Official Digital MP3 and Physical Music Submission Route
manual_review_reason: CKUT publicly authorizes 320-kbps MP3 digital submissions to music@ckut.ca and also accepts CDs, cassettes, 12-inch and 7-inch vinyl by mail or drop-off. Singles are rejected; except for 7-inch vinyl, a release must contain at least three distinct tracks and remixes do not count. Physical releases may receive more attention, but review is not guaranteed. A human must confirm that the selected release satisfies the multi-track rule, choose digital or physical delivery, prepare compliant metadata and assets and address any physical package exactly.

platform: PBS 106.7FM Official International Music Submission Form
manual_review_reason: PBS FM prefers its official digital form and explicitly accepts local and international acts. The form requests identity and location details, artist biography, social links, optional gigs, a stream link and a required free high-quality download link in 320-kbps AAC, MP3, WAV or equivalent; Spotify and Deezer links are not accepted. The page contains a blank anti-spam field and a human-verification CAPTCHA. A human must complete the CAPTCHA, inspect conditional country/state behavior, verify link permissions and approve all assets. Physical CDs or vinyl are also accepted with a one-page press release or bio.

platform: RTRFM 92.1 Official Overseas Form and Music Director Email Route
manual_review_reason: RTRFM accepts releases through its official form or the protected Music Team email shown on the same page. The form includes an Overseas location option, requests contact and artist details, a biography document, social links, upcoming gigs, a stream link and a free download link, and contains a hidden validation field that must remain unchanged. RTRFM recommends a downloadable WAV or high-quality MP3 link and says files must not be attached to email. A human must inspect the live form, leave the anti-spam field untouched, verify assets and link rights and confirm the protected email if choosing the email route.

platform: fbi.radio Official Digital Music Director Email Route
manual_review_reason: fbi.radio publicly directs music submissions to music@fbiradio.com and requires a clear subject, short bio, press image or gig details, a stream link and a free high-quality 320-kbps MP3 or WAV download link. Music for general playlisting must be serviced digitally before midnight Tuesday for Wednesday auditioning; CDs are no longer accepted. A human must prepare the pitch, confirm download permissions and expiry, select general or show-specific servicing and ensure all rights and metadata are correct before sending.
